steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Initialize package workspace for Modern Calculator targeting Android API 34 with Java 17.

steps.title: Configure Build Script
steps.description: Establish build.gradle configured for Gradle 8.5, AGP 8.3.2, and native Java 8 source compatibility.

steps.title: Establish App Manifest
steps.description: Register application component elements, orientation modes, and system hardware configuration targets.

steps.title: Define UI Resource Colors
steps.description: Set standard layout aesthetic constants including slate, orange, neutral shades, and high contrast accents.

steps.title: Build Rounded Key Drawables
steps.description: Create responsive background drawable shapes with modern curved profiles for regular, function, and accent keys.

steps.title: Implement User Interface Layout
steps.description: Establish a clean, ergonomic, and highly-adaptive keypad grid combined with active formulation/expression readouts.

steps.title: Implement Mathematical Parser Engine
steps.description: Establish parsing state logic for multi-operation sequencing conforming to standard algebraic order of operations.

steps.title: Setup Input Listeners
steps.description: Configure click handlers for system control keys (C, DEL, Percent, Decimal) and numerical values in Java 8.

steps.title: Enable Dynamic Evaluation
steps.description: Configure real-time expression parsing and instant dynamic solution feedback directly within the secondary preview.

steps.title: App Verification & Quality Assurance
steps.description: Validate layout consistency on multiple virtual configurations to assure UI integrity.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compile package targets, assemble binary builds, and produce the deployment package.
